name: PhoneZero Operator
description: Drives outbound calling through PhoneZero, taking its operating instructions from the Grok Bot sections of that project's own repo documentation. Only useful if you already run PhoneZero and can point the bot at the repo; without that setup there is nothing for it to operate.
